zip_layout: Wavedash build folder: index.html at the root, bundled game.js, game.wasm, runtime-build.json, and assets/game.ntpack. The host page injects its SDK into the frame, so nothing about it is bundled or linked.

sdk_policy.load_policy: The host page defines the Wavedash global inside the game frame before the game's own code runs. There is no script to load, self-host, or bundle, and no CDN URL to preserve.
sdk_policy.ads: unsupported; the platform carries no interstitial or rewarded inventory and monetizes through paid content
sdk_policy.storage: cloud saves are files: writeLocalFile into the player's IndexedDB, then uploadRemoteFile into the player's remote root
sdk_policy.leaderboards: read and write without a login, addressed by a board name resolved to its backend id
